analysis.session_summary: The tape was risk-on with commodity FX leading: AUD strength 0.315% and NZD strength 0.154% against majors, while DXY fell 0.059% and VIX fell 1.002%. UK CPI printed 3.5% vs 3.4% but GBP was muted, and no event produced a meaningful leg in EUR/USD, which chopped to only +1.4 pips. Most moves had no clear catalyst, with flow and technicals dominating.

themes.evidence: Most EUR/USD and major legs had cause null/confidence none; only BOE Bailey partially owned one USD/JPY leg (8.5 pips, 39%).

themes.theme: Commodity FX outperformance on soft USD
themes.evidence: AUD strength 0.315%, NZD 0.154%, while USD -0.155%; AUD/NZD rose 0.162%.

themes.theme: UK CPI failed to trigger GBP repricing
themes.evidence: CPI y/y 3.5% vs 3.4% but GBP basket impulse -0.028%, inside noise floor.

currency_drivers.USD: No clear catalyst; broad softness with DXY -0.059% despite risk-on.
currency_drivers.EUR: No clear catalyst; weakened, contributing to EUR/GBP decline.
currency_drivers.JPY: No clear catalyst; softer on crosses, but USD weakness dominated USD/JPY down.
currency_drivers.GBP: CPI 3.5% vs 3.4% and Bailey both muted; no directional impulse.
currency_drivers.AUD: No clear catalyst; strongest major, led risk-on gains.
currency_drivers.CAD: No clear catalyst; weakest major, underperformed all peers.
currency_drivers.CHF: No clear catalyst; mild strength, range-bound with risk appetite.
currency_drivers.NZD: No clear catalyst; firm, second-strongest after AUD.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD chopped through six legs for only +1.4 pips, closing 74% of a 25-pip range; no leg had a clear catalyst.

polarity_reads.read: Reaction muted (basket 0.015%) implies no new policy signal and GBP already positioned for current path.
Despite actual 3.5% vs forecast 3.4%, basket moved -0.028%, showing CPI beat was priced or offset.

scenarios.name: Risk-on continuation, commodity FX outperform
scenarios.thesis: USD softness persists and risk appetite holds; AUD/NZD stay bid; GBP catches no bid.
scenarios.invalidation: DXY reverses higher or VIX jumps

pair_paths.rationale: USD soft, EUR stable; range extension toward upper end of 25-pip range.
AUD top strength, risk-on supports 40.3-pip range continuation.

scenarios.name: USD stabilizes, GBP delayed CPI repricing
scenarios.thesis: DXY finds support; market reprices GBP on 3.5% CPI; EUR weakens.
scenarios.invalidation: AUD/NZD continue to lead, GBP stays muted

pair_paths.rationale: GBP catches up to CPI; range 38.8 pips.

scenarios.name: Risk-off shock
scenarios.thesis: Russia-Ukraine talks sour, VIX jumps; commodity FX unwinds, safe-havens bid.
scenarios.invalidation: US says Russians accepted trilateral meeting leads to ceasefire optimism

pair_paths.rationale: Carry unwind, AUD loses top rank.
JPY safe-haven bid, despite soft driver.

risks.why_it_matters: Could flip risk-on positioning and unwind AUD/NZD gains; USD/JPY and CHF could reverse.
risks.watch: Headlines from US official / Russia acceptance follow-up.

risks.why_it_matters: Could rewrite NZD strength; forecast 0.8% vs previous 1.5%.
USD softness could deepen or reverse; DXY already -0.059%.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: Coming window will be dominated by NZ CPI q/q at 23:45 (forecast 0.8% vs previous 1.5%) and US Unemployment Claims at 14:30 (forecast 200K vs previous 199K). These can shift NZD and USD and may provide the first catalyst-heavy session after a flow-only tape.
